## Overview

The Sovereign Design System provides a unified, cross-surface design architecture implemented in 100% pure Bun v1.4.4. It bridges Google Design, Material Design 3 (M3 Expressive), Microsoft Fluent 2, and Apple macOS windowing ergonomics across 7 distinct execution targets.

<CardGroup cols={3}>
  <Card title="Web Standards" icon="globe">
    Native CSS custom properties (`--md-sys-color-*`), responsive layout grids,
    and zero-layout-shift (`CLS = 0`).
  </Card>
  <Card title="Desktop Rust" icon="laptop">
    Direct bindings for `taffy`, Zed `GPUI`, System76 `COSMIC` RON, and
    Microsoft WinUI 3 Fluent 2 parity.
  </Card>
  <Card title="TUI & Terminals" icon="terminal">
    24-bit TrueColor ANSI escape sequences and Rio terminal configs with crisp
    Unicode box-drawing glyphs.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

---

## Architecture Principles

<Steps>
  <Step title="CAM16 & HCT Perceptual Math">
    Color luminance and chroma are calculated via Google's official CAM16 color
    appearance model, guaranteeing contrast accessibility.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Universal Multi-Surface Compilation">
    From any single seed hex or image palette, design tokens compile
    simultaneously for Web, Figma, Stitch, Gemini Canvas, Desktop Rust, Mobile,
    and TUI.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Automated Gate Verification">
    Compile-time gates audit design artifacts against rogue hex values, off-grid
    dimensions, and contrast regressions.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Info>
  All components and utilities are powered natively by Bun with zero external
  npm dependencies.
</Info>
